testcase.name: Scenario: Toggle full and tabs-only display by double-clicking the active tab: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-display-source/features/application/ribbon-display/ribbon-display.feature:691:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Toggle full and tabs-only display by double-clicking the active tab ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the full Tools ribbon is visible ✔ When the user double-clicks the active Tools tab ✔ Then the ribbon shows its tabs without permanent command groups ✔ When the user double-clicks the active Tools tab again ✔ Then the full Tools command groups are visible again ✔ And the part remains active
